title: Use threat modeling to improve a design before it fails: concept decisions 2
teachingQuestion: Which model elements and method expose the plausible abuse path, and what decision must result?
focalInsight: Bound the system with assets, actors, flows, and trust boundaries; choose methods for the question; own treatment.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.
